message.creaturestudio.unknown_creature: That creature no longer exists in this world.
message.creaturestudio.too_big: The creature is too big to send.
message.creaturestudio.invalid: The creature data could not be read.
message.creaturestudio.no_permission: You are not allowed to modify "%s".
message.creaturestudio.too_many: This world reached the limit of %s creatures.
message.creaturestudio.need_egg: In survival you need 1 chicken egg to make a creature egg.
message.creaturestudio.need_creative: Direct summoning only works in creative or as an operator.
gui.creaturestudio.library.title: Creature Studio
gui.creaturestudio.library.delete_messag: "%s" will be deleted and all of its creatures will vanish from the world. This cannot be undone.
gui.creaturestudio.library.empty: There are no creatures in this world yet. Press "+ New creature" to create the first one.
gui.creaturestudio.library.no_selection: Select a creature from the list.
gui.creaturestudio.library.hint: Drag to rotate · Wheel: zoom · Double click: edit
gui.creaturestudio.import.title: Import creature
gui.creaturestudio.import.empty: No files yet. Export a creature or copy .json files shared by other players here.
gui.creaturestudio.import.failed: %s is not a valid creature file.
gui.creaturestudio.editor.title: Creature editor
gui.creaturestudio.editor.name: Creature name
gui.creaturestudio.editor.no_parts: No parts. Press "+ Cube" to add the first one.
gui.creaturestudio.editor.part.add_toolt: Adds a cube on top of the selected part (as its child)
gui.creaturestudio.editor.part.duplicate: Copies the part and its children (Ctrl+D)
gui.creaturestudio.editor.part.delete_to: Deletes the part (Delete key). Its children move to its parent.
gui.creaturestudio.editor.part.mirror_to: Creates a mirrored copy on the other side (great for eyes, legs and wings)
gui.creaturestudio.editor.part.center_to: Centers the model and puts it on the ground
gui.creaturestudio.editor.field.name: Name
gui.creaturestudio.editor.field.parent_t: The part moves and rotates together with the part it is attached to (e.g. an eye attached to the head).
gui.creaturestudio.editor.field.stretch: Stretch the texture on each face
gui.creaturestudio.editor.hint.fields: Click a field and use the mouse wheel or the ↑↓ keys (Shift: fine · Ctrl: ×5). With no field active, the arrow keys and PgUp/PgDn move the part. The creature's front faces -Z.
gui.creaturestudio.editor.hint.look: The texture is tinted with the color: use white to see its original colors. In the last field you can type any block texture, e.g. minecraft:block/stone.
gui.creaturestudio.editor.hint.anim: Animations rotate the part around its pivot (Shape tab) and the parts attached to it follow. Use A and B on opposite limbs so they alternate.
gui.creaturestudio.editor.hint.stats: For reference: a zombie has 20 health, 3 strength, 0.23 speed and sees 35 blocks away. Scale multiplies the model size. 20 ticks = 1 second.
gui.creaturestudio.editor.hint.ai: "Tempted by item": the creature follows you while you hold that item (e.g. minecraft:wheat). Press ▾ to search the list.
gui.creaturestudio.editor.hint.spawn: Comma separated biomes, e.g. minecraft:plains, #minecraft:is_forest. The chance is rolled every 5 seconds per player.
gui.creaturestudio.editor.preview.help: Drag: rotate · Right drag: pan · Wheel: zoom toward the mouse · Click a part: select it · F: fit · H: hide the panel
gui.creaturestudio.editor.preview.help_b: Drag: rotate · Right drag: pan · Wheel: zoom toward the mouse · F: fit · H: hide the panel
gui.creaturestudio.editor.too_big: Model too big: remove some parts.
gui.creaturestudio.tab.template.desc: Start from a ready-made model, then change it as you like in the other tabs.
gui.creaturestudio.tab.parts.desc: The cubes that make up the body. Add, copy, mirror, delete and attach parts.
gui.creaturestudio.tab.shape.desc: Position, size and rotation of the selected part. Measured in pixels: 16 = 1 block.
gui.creaturestudio.tab.paint.desc: Color, texture and hand painting of the part. You can also change the color of the whole creature at once or put a whole PNG skin on it (e.g. a villager's).
gui.creaturestudio.tab.animate.desc: How the creature moves: automatic animations for each part, or your own animations made with poses (walk, attack...).
gui.creaturestudio.tab.stats.desc: Health, melee and ranged attack, projectile, respawn, resistances, regeneration, vision, block breaking and immunities.
gui.creaturestudio.tab.behavior.desc: Whether it is friendly or attacks, walks, swims or flies, what tempts it and which sounds it makes.
gui.creaturestudio.tab.spawn.desc: Where it appears on its own in the world (place, biomes and structures) and its egg colors.
gui.creaturestudio.templates.warning: Choosing a template replaces the current model and settings. Changed your mind? Press Ctrl+Z.
gui.creaturestudio.templates.hint: Hover over a template to see it in the 3D view, and click to use it.
gui.creaturestudio.editor.no_parts_here: This model has no parts yet. Add them in the Body tab (ready-made parts) or in Parts (cubes).
gui.creaturestudio.editor.piece_pick: Pick the part from a list. You can also click it in the 3D view.
gui.creaturestudio.editor.pivot.center_t: Moves the rotation point to the center of the cube
gui.creaturestudio.recolor.open_tip: Changes the color of the whole creature at once without losing its shades: if it is red and light red, it becomes blue and light blue.
gui.creaturestudio.recolor.none: This creature has no colors yet.
gui.creaturestudio.recolor.all_tip: All its colors become shades of the new color (white, black and grays stay).
gui.creaturestudio.recolor.only_tip: Only that color and its shades change; the rest stays as it is.
gui.creaturestudio.recolor.reset_tip: Goes back to the colors from before you started changing this one.
gui.creaturestudio.recolor.hint: Shades are kept: light stays light and dark stays dark. It changes the color of the parts, the hand painting and the mini-blocks; Minecraft block textures don't change. Ctrl+Z undoes it.
gui.creaturestudio.paint.stretch_tip: The whole texture covers each face of the cube instead of repeating. Great for eyes and mouths.
gui.creaturestudio.paint.glow_tip: The part is drawn at full brightness even in the dark.
gui.creaturestudio.behavior.passive.desc: Never attacks. Runs away when hit.
gui.creaturestudio.behavior.neutral.desc: Minds its own business, but fights back when attacked.
gui.creaturestudio.behavior.hostile.desc: Chases and attacks the players it sees.
gui.creaturestudio.ai.sound_tooltip: Use the sounds of a Minecraft mob
gui.creaturestudio.spawn.natural_tip: When off, the creature only appears from its egg or with "Summon".
gui.creaturestudio.egg.preview: This is how the egg will look
gui.creaturestudio.library.new_tooltip: Create a new creature starting from a template
gui.creaturestudio.library.import_toolti: Load a creature from a .json file
gui.creaturestudio.library.edit_tooltip: Open the editor (also double click or Enter)
gui.creaturestudio.library.duplicate_too: Makes a copy to create a variant
gui.creaturestudio.library.egg_tooltip: Gives you an egg to place the creature. In survival it costs 1 chicken egg.
gui.creaturestudio.library.summon_toolti: Spawns the creature next to you (creative or operator only).
gui.creaturestudio.library.export_toolti: Saves the creature as a .json file to share it
gui.creaturestudio.editor.preview.mouse_: Use the mouse to move, stretch and paint parts directly in the 3D view (M key)
gui.creaturestudio.tool.move.help: Drag the part or its X/Y/Z arrows to move it · Shift: fine step · Click the background: rotate the view · Right drag: pan
gui.creaturestudio.tool.resize.help: Drag the little squares on the faces to grow or shrink the part · Shift: fine step · Click the background: rotate the view
gui.creaturestudio.tool.brush.help: Click and drag on the model to paint pixel by pixel · -/+: brush size · Click the background: rotate the view
gui.creaturestudio.tool.eraser.help: Drag over the model to erase paint (the texture underneath shows again)
gui.creaturestudio.tool.picker.help: Click the model to copy that color to the brush
gui.creaturestudio.tool.color_tip: Brush color: change it in the Paint tab
gui.creaturestudio.tool.shape_off: Tip: turn on "Mouse" to move and stretch the part by dragging it in the 3D view.
gui.creaturestudio.vanilla.title: Minecraft models (%s)
gui.creaturestudio.vanilla.hint: Every entity in the game. Hover to see them and click to load their shape and texture; then edit them as you like. Your stats and behavior stay the same.
gui.creaturestudio.vanilla.failed: That model could not be loaded.
gui.creaturestudio.paint.mouse_off: Turn on the brush and paint directly on the model in the 3D view.
gui.creaturestudio.paint.clear_part_tip: Removes the hand painting of this part
gui.creaturestudio.paint.clear_all_tip: Removes the hand painting of every part (Ctrl+Z undoes it)
gui.creaturestudio.paint.hint: You can paint on any part without selecting it first. Paint shows on top of the base color and texture; the eraser removes it. Keys: B brush, E eraser, I picker, M mouse.
gui.creaturestudio.paint.too_much: This creature has too much paint: erase some before painting another part.
gui.creaturestudio.tab.easy.desc: Ready-made body parts: click one to add it in place (head, arms, legs, tail, wings...), then change its size, position or color with buttons.
gui.creaturestudio.editor.easy_tooltip: Shows only the basics: ready-to-use body parts, templates and painting. Turn it off to see every tab.
gui.creaturestudio.editor.easy_on: Easy mode: Body, Templates and Paint tabs
gui.creaturestudio.editor.panel.collapse: Hide the panel for more room (H key)
gui.creaturestudio.editor.panel.resize: Drag the edge to change the panel width
gui.creaturestudio.editor.preview.animat: The creature breathes and looks around in the 3D view
gui.creaturestudio.editor.preview.reset_: Centers and fits the model (F key)
gui.creaturestudio.easy.empty: Click a part to start. For example: Body 2 legs, then Head, Arms and Legs.
gui.creaturestudio.easy.symmetry_tip: Size, position, color and texture changes also apply to the part on the other side (arm, leg, ear, wing...).
gui.creaturestudio.easy.bigger_tip: Makes the part and the parts attached to it bigger
gui.creaturestudio.easy.smaller_tip: Makes the part and the parts attached to it smaller
gui.creaturestudio.easy.apart_tip: Moves both parts away from the center
gui.creaturestudio.easy.together_tip: Moves both parts toward the center
gui.creaturestudio.easy.mirror_tip: Creates the same part mirrored on the other side
gui.creaturestudio.easy.delete_tip: Deletes the part (and the one on the other side if symmetry is on). Ctrl+Z undoes it.
gui.creaturestudio.easy.hint: Tip: click a part in the 3D view to select it. With «Mouse» on you can drag and stretch it. For finer control, turn off easy mode.
gui.creaturestudio.easy.painted: This part has a texture painted on top (from a Minecraft model or a skin): the color and texture only show where there is no paint.
gui.creaturestudio.easy.clear_paint_tip: Erases this part's paint (and the other side's with symmetry) so its color and texture show. Ctrl+Z undoes it.
An upright torso, like a person or a zombie. Add it first.
gui.creaturestudio.easy.part.body_quadru: A horizontal body, like a cow or a wolf.
gui.creaturestudio.easy.part.head: Head
gui.creaturestudio.easy.part.head.desc: A head with eyes, on top of or in front of the body. It looks around.
gui.creaturestudio.easy.part.eyes.desc: Two eyes on the face (a head is created if needed).
gui.creaturestudio.easy.part.ears.desc: Two ears on top of the head.
gui.creaturestudio.easy.part.snout.desc: A snout or nose in front of the head.
gui.creaturestudio.easy.part.antennae.de: Two insect antennae on the head.
gui.creaturestudio.easy.part.arms.desc: Two arms at the sides of the body that swing when walking.
gui.creaturestudio.easy.part.legs.desc: Two legs (2-leg body) or four legs (4-leg body) that move when walking.
gui.creaturestudio.easy.part.spider_legs: Eight legs at the sides, like a spider.
gui.creaturestudio.easy.part.tail.desc: A tail behind the body that wags.
gui.creaturestudio.easy.part.wings.desc: Two feathered wings that flap. To make it fly, turn off easy mode and choose Fly in Behavior.
gui.creaturestudio.easy.part.fins.desc: Two scaly fins at the sides.
gui.creaturestudio.skin.import_tip: Put a PNG image on the creature, for example a villager skin downloaded from the internet. Copy it into the creaturestudio folder first.
gui.creaturestudio.skin.export_tip: Saves the creature's full texture as a PNG so you can paint it in another program and import it back.
gui.creaturestudio.skin.folder_tip: Opens the .minecraft/creaturestudio folder, where skins go
gui.creaturestudio.skin.none: No skin yet. To use a mob's skin (e.g. a villager), first load its model in Templates → Minecraft models, then import it here.
gui.creaturestudio.skin.applied_some: Skin applied: %s. %s new parts have no place in it and stay the same.
gui.creaturestudio.skin.applied_layout: Skin applied with the creature's own layout: %s
gui.creaturestudio.skin.exported: Skin saved in the creaturestudio folder: %s
gui.creaturestudio.skin.failed_write: The skin could not be saved.
gui.creaturestudio.skinpick.title: Choose a skin (PNG)
gui.creaturestudio.skinpick.hint: Copy the .png image into the creaturestudio folder («Open folder» button) and click it. Hover over it to preview it.
gui.creaturestudio.skinpick.no_skin: Your creature doesn't come from a Minecraft model: the image will be placed with its own layout (the one from «Export skin»).
gui.creaturestudio.skinpick.empty: There are no .png images in the folder. Download a skin, copy it into .minecraft/creaturestudio and press Refresh.
gui.creaturestudio.skinpick.hover: Hover over a file to see it here
gui.creaturestudio.skinpick.unreadable: This image can't be read (is it a PNG?)
gui.creaturestudio.skinpick.mismatch: Your creature uses %s×%s: some parts may not fit.
gui.creaturestudio.anim.none.desc: The part does not move by itself (but still follows its parent).
gui.creaturestudio.anim.head: Head
gui.creaturestudio.anim.head.desc: Looks where the creature looks: up/down and sideways.
gui.creaturestudio.anim.leg_a.desc: Swings back and forth while walking. Use A on one leg and B on the other.
gui.creaturestudio.anim.leg_b.desc: Like leg A but on the opposite step.
gui.creaturestudio.anim.arm_a.desc: Swings while walking and punches forward when attacking.
gui.creaturestudio.anim.arm_b.desc: Like arm A but on the opposite step.
gui.creaturestudio.anim.side_leg_a.desc: For legs pointing sideways (spiders, insects): sweeps forward and back.
gui.creaturestudio.anim.side_leg_b.desc: Like A but on the opposite step. Alternate them along the body.
gui.creaturestudio.anim.wing_a.desc: Flaps up and down; very fast while flying. For the wing on the left (+X) side.
gui.creaturestudio.anim.wing_b.desc: Mirrored version of the other wing. "Mirror X" assigns it automatically.
gui.creaturestudio.anim.tail.desc: Wags sideways. On chains of parts it creates a wavy motion.
gui.creaturestudio.anim.bob.desc: Moves gently up and down, like breathing or a bouncing slime.
gui.creaturestudio.anim.jaw.desc: Opens a little now and then and fully when attacking. Put the pivot at the hinge.
gui.creaturestudio.anim.spin.desc: Spins non-stop around its vertical axis (propellers, rings, crystals...).
gui.creaturestudio.anim.sway.desc: Leans from side to side while walking, great for bodies.
gui.creaturestudio.respawn.enabled_tip: When killed, it comes back after the given time (even if you close the world). It does not come back if it despawns for being far away.
gui.creaturestudio.respawn.hint: "At its home" is the place where it first appeared. With daytime or night it waits for that time (in the Nether and the End it comes back at any time).
gui.creaturestudio.melee.hint: Speed = ticks between hits (20 ticks = 1 second; lower is faster). Range is measured from the edge of its body.
gui.creaturestudio.ranged.preset_hint: Each type fills everything below with example values; then change whatever you like.
gui.creaturestudio.ranged.aim_tip: Yes: it stands still aiming while it shoots. No: it shoots without stopping.
gui.creaturestudio.ranged.hint: Delay = ticks between bursts, random between min and max (20 ticks = 1 second). Melee range 0 = never fights in melee. Arcs only work if the projectile has gravity.
gui.creaturestudio.indirect.no.tip: Always shoots straight at the target.
gui.creaturestudio.indirect.yes.tip: Always shoots in an arc like a mortar; it can shoot over walls.
gui.creaturestudio.indirect.distant.tip: Shoots in an arc when the target is farther than half the range.
gui.creaturestudio.indirect.hidden.tip: Shoots in an arc when it cannot see the target (for example behind a wall).
gui.creaturestudio.proj.gravity_tip: Yes: it slowly falls like an arrow. No: it flies straight like a fireball.
gui.creaturestudio.proj.3d_tip: The item is shown in 3D pointing where it flies (like an arrow or a trident).
gui.creaturestudio.proj.2d_tip: It is flat and always faces the camera (like a snowball).
gui.creaturestudio.proj.sticks_tip: It stays stuck in the block for a few seconds, like an arrow. Otherwise it disappears on impact.
gui.creaturestudio.proj.hint: Size 5 = normal. Speed 10 ≈ a skeleton arrow. Explosions only break blocks if the mobGriefing rule is on.
gui.creaturestudio.resist.hint: Removes that percentage of the damage (or knockback). 100 % = immune. "Arrows" covers all projectiles.
gui.creaturestudio.regen.hint: Health it recovers every second (2 = one heart). While fighting, or if it was hurt less than 5 seconds ago, it uses combat regen.
gui.creaturestudio.range.walls_tip: It can find players even with blocks in between.
gui.creaturestudio.range.hint: Vision: how far away it notices a player. Follow: how far it chases before giving up (if lower than vision, vision is used).
gui.creaturestudio.break.enabled_tip: It breaks the blocks in its way to reach what it attacks: walls, doors, the floor...
gui.creaturestudio.break.all_tip: Any block, except unbreakable ones (bedrock, portals...).
gui.creaturestudio.break.list_tip: Only the blocks in the list (or those of a group, which start with #).
gui.creaturestudio.break.add_tip: Adds a row: type the block or pick it from the list with the button on the right.
gui.creaturestudio.break.group.dirt.tip: Everything you break with a shovel: dirt, sand, gravel, snow... (#minecraft:mineable/shovel)
gui.creaturestudio.break.group.stone.tip: Everything you break with a pickaxe: stone, ores, bricks, metal... (#minecraft:mineable/pickaxe)
gui.creaturestudio.break.group.wood.tip: Everything you break with an axe: logs, planks, chests... (#minecraft:mineable/axe)
gui.creaturestudio.break.group.doors.tip: Every door, like a zombie on hard (#minecraft:doors)
gui.creaturestudio.break.empty: The list is empty: it won't break anything.
gui.creaturestudio.break.hardness_tip: Yes: that time is for stone; dirt takes a third and obsidian 8 times longer. No: every block takes the same.
gui.creaturestudio.break.passive: It is passive: it never chases anyone, so it won't break anything. Make it neutral or hostile in Behavior.
gui.creaturestudio.break.hint: It breaks blocks when something stops it from reaching what it attacks. With more than 1 block per hit it also breaks the ones next to it (first those in its way). 0 seconds = instantly. It drops what it breaks. Needs the mobGriefing rule (on by default).
gui.creaturestudio.ai.moved_to_stats: Ranged attack, hit effect and immunities are now in the Stats tab.
gui.creaturestudio.spawn.loot_moved: What it drops on death is now in the Inventory tab.
gui.creaturestudio.tab.inventory.desc: What it wears (armor, weapons, shield and projectile) and up to 10 items it drops when it dies.
gui.creaturestudio.inv.head: Helmet
gui.creaturestudio.inv.equipment_hint: Type the item id or press ▾ to search for it. It raises the shield when the enemy is close (if it holds something else in the left hand, it swaps it for the shield while blocking). The projectile is the look of what it shoots (see Stats).
gui.creaturestudio.inv.hint: Each item has its own chance (100 % = always). The amount is random between the two numbers.
gui.creaturestudio.field.item_pick: Pick from the game's item list (if you typed part of a name, only matching items are shown)
gui.creaturestudio.field.block_pick: Pick from the game's block list (if you typed part of a name, only matching blocks are shown)
gui.creaturestudio.tab.abilities.desc: Special powers copied from Minecraft mobs: explode like a creeper, hear like the warden, teleport like an enderman and many more.
gui.creaturestudio.ability.hint: Hover over each ability to see what it does. You can combine as many as you like.
gui.creaturestudio.ability.explode: Creeper: explodes when someone gets close
gui.creaturestudio.ability.explode.tip: When a player (or its target) gets close, it stops, swells hissing and explodes. If you move away in time, it calms down.
gui.creaturestudio.ability.explode.dies_: Yes: like a creeper, it explodes and disappears (no loot). No: it survives and can explode again after the cooldown.
gui.creaturestudio.ability.explode.hint: Medium = like a creeper. It only breaks blocks if the mobGriefing rule is on. 30 ticks = 1.5 seconds.
gui.creaturestudio.ability.last_blast.ti: When it has few hearts left it swells up and explodes. If it is killed in one hit before that, it explodes as it dies.
gui.creaturestudio.ability.last_blast.hi: 0 hearts = it only explodes when it dies. Fuse 0 = it explodes at once (30 ticks = 1.5 seconds). When it explodes it dies and drops its loot. It only breaks blocks if the mobGriefing rule is on.
gui.creaturestudio.ability.blind: Warden: can't see you, but hears you
gui.creaturestudio.ability.blind.tip: It doesn't find you by sight: it finds you by noise (walking, running, hitting), even through walls. If you sneak and stay quiet, it can't hear you.
gui.creaturestudio.ability.blind.hint: Sneak (Shift) so it can't hear you. If you stay silent for 5 seconds, it loses you. It only hunts players if its behaviour is Hostile.
gui.creaturestudio.ability.sonic.tip: It charges a scream and fires it straight at its target: it goes through walls and shields and knocks back hard.
gui.creaturestudio.ability.sonic.hint: It takes 1.7 seconds to charge; it stands still meanwhile.
gui.creaturestudio.ability.teleport.tip: It vanishes and reappears somewhere nearby: to dodge arrows, when it gets hit or to get closer to its target.
gui.creaturestudio.ability.stare: Enderman: gets angry if you look it in the eyes
gui.creaturestudio.ability.stare.tip: If a player looks straight at it, it attacks them (even if it is passive). A carved pumpkin on your head protects you.
gui.creaturestudio.ability.stare.hint: With this ability, even a Passive creature fights when you look at it.
gui.creaturestudio.ability.beam.tip: It stands still aiming a beam that changes color while charging; when it finishes it deals magic damage (ignores armor).
gui.creaturestudio.ability.beam.hint: If the target hides behind something, the beam is cut.
gui.creaturestudio.ability.thorns.tip: Whoever hits it in melee also takes damage.
gui.creaturestudio.ability.aura.tip: Every so often, nearby players get an effect (mining fatigue like the elder guardian, or another).
gui.creaturestudio.ability.split.tip: When it dies, several smaller pieces of the same creature come out.
gui.creaturestudio.ability.split.hint: Each piece is half the size, with half the health and strength. Pieces don't respawn.
gui.creaturestudio.ability.climb.tip: It climbs walls like a spider.
gui.creaturestudio.ability.leap.tip: When it's close to its target, it jumps at it.
gui.creaturestudio.ability.night: Spider: neutral by day, hostile at night
gui.creaturestudio.ability.night.tip: In the dark (at night or in a cave) it attacks the players it sees; in the light it is neutral: it only fights back if attacked.
gui.creaturestudio.ability.night.hint: Like the spider, what counts is the light where it is: at night next to torches it calms down, and in a cave it is hostile even during the day. In the light it slowly stops chasing. It overrides its behavior (passive, neutral or hostile).
gui.creaturestudio.ability.launch: Iron golem: throws into the air
gui.creaturestudio.ability.launch.tip: When it hits, it throws its target upwards.
gui.creaturestudio.ability.heal.tip: When its health is low, it drinks a potion and heals.
gui.creaturestudio.ability.heal.hint: It drinks when it has less than half its health (2 = one heart).
gui.creaturestudio.ability.life_steal.ti: Every time it hurts someone it heals part of that damage: with its hits, projectiles, beam, roar and charge.
gui.creaturestudio.ability.life_steal.hi: 50 = if it takes 4 health from you (2 hearts), it heals 2. Above 100 it heals more than it takes.
gui.creaturestudio.ability.eat.tip: When its health is low it stops to eat: the food it carries or food it sees lying nearby.
gui.creaturestudio.ability.eat.ground: Looks for food on the ground
gui.creaturestudio.ability.eat.ground_ti: If it carries no food (or runs out), it goes for food it sees lying nearby and eats it.
gui.creaturestudio.ability.eat.hint: Eating takes 1.6 seconds and it heals twice what that food fills (a steak heals 8 hearts). Each creature carries its own food. Food on the ground needs the mobGriefing rule.
gui.creaturestudio.ability.summon.tip: While fighting, it makes other mobs appear to help it (vexes, zombies... or another creature of yours).
gui.creaturestudio.ability.summon.hint: Type a mob (vex, zombie, minecraft:skeleton...) or the id of another creature of yours, or press ▾ to choose. It only summons when it has someone to attack.
gui.creaturestudio.ability.charge.tip: It runs straight at its target and, if it hits, sends it flying.
gui.creaturestudio.ability.pack.tip: If it gets attacked, nearby creatures of the same kind attack too.
gui.creaturestudio.ability.ink.tip: When hurt, it releases an ink cloud that blinds the attacker for a few seconds.
gui.creaturestudio.ability.deflect.tip: Arrows and other projectiles bounce back towards whoever shot them.
gui.creaturestudio.ability.slow_fall.tip: It glides down and takes no fall damage.
gui.creaturestudio.ability.lay.tip: Every so often it drops an item (an egg or another one you choose).
gui.creaturestudio.ability.milk.tip: If you use an item on it (right click), it gives you another: a bucket gives a milk bucket, shears give wool...
gui.creaturestudio.ability.milk.uses: The item is swapped for the result
gui.creaturestudio.ability.milk.uses_tip: Yes: like the bucket, which becomes a milk bucket. No: you keep the item and get the result separately (like shears and wool).
gui.creaturestudio.ability.doors.tip: What it does with the wooden doors in its way.
gui.creaturestudio.ability.trail.tip: It leaves blocks wherever it walks.
gui.creaturestudio.ability.trail.hint: Only if the mobGriefing rule is on. Fire and cobwebs are left behind it.
gui.creaturestudio.ability.glows: Glow squid: glows in the dark
gui.creaturestudio.ability.glows.tip: It looks lit even in the dark.
gui.creaturestudio.ability.pick_up.tip: It picks up the items it finds; if they are better weapons or armor, it equips them.
gui.creaturestudio.ability.fear: Creeper: is afraid of another mob
gui.creaturestudio.ability.fear.tip: It runs away when that mob gets close (like creepers from cats).
gui.creaturestudio.field.entity_pick: Pick from the list of mobs and your creatures
gui.creaturestudio.paint.mode: What do you want to do
gui.creaturestudio.paint.mode.pixels_tip: Paint on the faces of the parts, pixel by pixel.
gui.creaturestudio.paint.mode.voxels_tip: Build with one-pixel cubes stuck to the parts: helmets, armor, crowns...
gui.creaturestudio.voxel.mouse_off: Turn on the mouse and build with mini-blocks directly on the model in the 3D view.
gui.creaturestudio.voxel.tool.brush.help: Click the model: places a mini-block on that face. Drag to cover a whole layer; another stroke on top adds the next layer.
gui.creaturestudio.voxel.tool.eraser.hel: Eraser: click or drag over mini-blocks to remove them.
gui.creaturestudio.voxel.tool.picker.hel: Click a mini-block (or a part) to copy its color and size.
gui.creaturestudio.voxel.place_tip: Adds new mini-blocks where you click.
gui.creaturestudio.voxel.recolor_tip: Doesn't add new ones: changes the color of the mini-blocks you touch.
gui.creaturestudio.voxel.size.quarter.ti: A quarter of a pixel: for very fine details (eyes, whiskers, rivets). Four fit along one pixel.
gui.creaturestudio.voxel.size.half.tip: Half a pixel: for fine details. Two fit along one pixel.
gui.creaturestudio.voxel.size.one.tip: One pixel: the usual size, like the pixels of Minecraft's textures.
gui.creaturestudio.voxel.size.two.tip: Two pixels: to fill big shapes quickly.
gui.creaturestudio.voxel.size.four.tip: Four pixels (a quarter of a block): for big shapes.
gui.creaturestudio.voxel.mirror_tip: Whatever you place on one side also appears on the other: on the same part if it is centered, or on its pair (arm, leg...).
gui.creaturestudio.voxel.templates_hint: They are placed on the chosen part (%s) with the color and size above (smaller mini-blocks make it finer). With mirror on, also on its pair.
gui.creaturestudio.voxel.template.helmet: Covers the head, leaving the face free. Put it on the head.
A ring with spikes on top of the part.
Two horns coming out of the top.
gui.creaturestudio.voxel.template.halo.t: A ring floating above the head.
In front of the mouth and hanging from the chin. Put it on the head.
gui.creaturestudio.voxel.template.chestp: Wraps the body on all four sides.
gui.creaturestudio.voxel.template.belt.t: A band at the bottom of the body, with a buckle.
gui.creaturestudio.voxel.template.cape.t: Hangs down the back, below the body.
gui.creaturestudio.voxel.template.should: On top of the arm and down the outer side. Put it on an arm.
Wrap the bottom of the leg, with a toe cap. Put them on a leg.
gui.creaturestudio.voxel.clear_part_tip: Removes all mini-blocks from the chosen part.
gui.creaturestudio.voxel.clear_all_tip: Removes the mini-blocks from every part.
gui.creaturestudio.voxel.hint: Mini-blocks stick to the part you click and move and animate with it. You can mix sizes on the same part. Ctrl+Z undoes.
gui.creaturestudio.tool.pose.help: Drag a part to rotate it in the chosen pose (it turns around its pivot, as you see it) · Turn the view to move it another way · Shift: 15 degrees at a time · Click the background: rotate the view
gui.creaturestudio.animate.mode.auto_tip: Ready-made motions for each part: leg, arm, tail, wings...
gui.creaturestudio.animate.mode.custom_t: Make your own animations with poses: idle, walk, attack, get hurt...
gui.creaturestudio.animate.custom_wins: This part also moves in your animations: while they play, yours wins.
gui.creaturestudio.custom.action.idle.ti: Loops while it stands still (when it starts walking, it blends into walking).
gui.creaturestudio.custom.action.walk.ti: Loops while walking, in step with its feet.
gui.creaturestudio.custom.action.fly.tip: Loops while flying (only creatures that fly, while in the air).
Once, every time it hits in melee.
gui.creaturestudio.custom.action.ability: Once, when it uses an ability: sonic boom, beam, charge, summon or heal.
gui.creaturestudio.custom.action.death.t: When it dies: it stays in the last pose until it vanishes (after a second). With this animation it no longer falls on its side.
gui.creaturestudio.custom.none: This action has no animation of its own yet: it uses the automatic ones.
gui.creaturestudio.custom.create_tip: Starts with the poses in the normal stance. Then move the parts in each pose.
gui.creaturestudio.custom.how: How it works: an animation is a series of poses. Pick a pose, place the parts, and the creature moves smoothly from one pose to the next.
gui.creaturestudio.custom.add_pose_tip: Adds a pose after this one (it starts as a copy of this one).
gui.creaturestudio.custom.opposite_tip: Puts the opposite pose in the next one: left becomes right and the other way round. A pose and its opposite make a full walking step.
gui.creaturestudio.custom.mouse_off: Easiest: turn on Pose and drag the parts in the 3D view. You can also use the bars below.
gui.creaturestudio.custom.turn_tip: Rotates the part around its pivot. What hangs from it follows. Shift: 15 at a time.
gui.creaturestudio.custom.move_tip: Moves the part (and what hangs from it) in this pose.
gui.creaturestudio.custom.reset_piece: This part, in its normal stance
gui.creaturestudio.custom.reset_piece_ti: Removes the rotation and movement of the part in this pose.
gui.creaturestudio.custom.play_tip: Plays the animation in the 3D view. One-time ones repeat every now and then.
gui.creaturestudio.custom.walk_time: Follows its steps: the faster it walks, the faster it goes.
gui.creaturestudio.custom.delete_tip: This action goes back to the automatic animations (Ctrl+Z undoes).
gui.creaturestudio.custom.hint: Parts you move in your animation stop using their automatic animation while it plays (the head keeps looking). The rest work as usual.
gui.creaturestudio.spawn.where_intro: Pick where in the world it looks for a spot or, if you want, which structures it appears in.
gui.creaturestudio.spawn_place.surface.t: On top of the terrain, under the open sky (flyers a little above the ground).
gui.creaturestudio.spawn_place.undergrou: In caves and hollows with no sky above. In the Nether, in any open space.
gui.creaturestudio.spawn_place.water.tip: Inside the water of rivers, lakes and oceans. Turn off "Can drown" so it does not drown.
gui.creaturestudio.spawn_place.sky.tip: High above the ground. Only for flyers: the others appear on the surface.
gui.creaturestudio.structure.village.tip: In plains, deserts, savannas, taigas and snowy plains.
gui.creaturestudio.structure.mansion.tip: In dark forests, very far from spawn.
gui.creaturestudio.structure.jungle_pyra: The mossy stone temple in the jungle.
gui.creaturestudio.structure.igloo.tip: In snowy plains and snowy taigas.
gui.creaturestudio.structure.trail_ruins: Half-buried ruins in forests and taigas.
gui.creaturestudio.structure.ruined_port: Nether portal remains, in the Overworld and in the Nether.
Underground, where the End portal is.
gui.creaturestudio.structure.ancient_cit: At the very bottom, in the deep dark.
gui.creaturestudio.structure.monument.ti: Under the deep ocean (full of water inside).
gui.creaturestudio.structure.shipwreck.t: In the ocean and on beaches.
gui.creaturestudio.structure.bastion.tip: The piglins' castle, in the Nether.
gui.creaturestudio.structure.end_city.ti: The purpur towers on the End islands.
gui.creaturestudio.spawn.structures_clea: Back to appearing in the chosen place, outside structures.
gui.creaturestudio.spawn.where_hint: If you tick structures, it only appears inside them (the place does not matter) and only when one is near a player. In "Others" you can type structures from other mods separated by commas, e.g. minecraft:igloo or #minecraft:village.
